**What this changes**

**How it was checked**

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (lint, types, tests, build, the packed package, one item bundled)
- [ ] `pnpm test:demo` passes, if the demo or a drawing changed
- [ ] `pnpm test:readme` passes, if the README's or the docs' examples changed, or an emblem was added (`pnpm gallery`)
- [ ] An emblem made from a source has its row in `NOTICE.md` and its licence text in `LICENSES/`
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md`, if a user would notice
